title: The new pen, worn
logline: The pen bought in November, ten months on: the barrel's black already worn gray in three places where the fingers go. The old one beside it, worn to metal. The page draws the two wears and says nothing about time.

panels.composition: Two brush pens on a drafting table under the lamp, one worn to bare metal in three places and the other newer with its black worn gray in the same three places.
